popularWikipediaSelection.source: OneZoom popularity index, based on English Wikipedia; https://www.onezoom.org/popularity
popularWikipediaSelection.sourceMethod: The OneZoom raw popularity score combines truncated average monthly English Wikipedia page views over recent years with article size. It is an index, not a direct page-view count.
popularWikipediaSelection.selection: Candidate pool: top 100 OneZoom species per major animal clade (mammals, birds, amphibians, bony/cartilaginous fish, insects, molluscs, annelids, cnidarians, echinoderms, reptiles); sorted by raw popularity. Take first 200 unique species with a Persian Wikidata label, a Commons image, and a unique species node in OpenTree; exclude Homo sapiens.
